sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

observed.name: VISITORS CENTER AT FURNACE CREEK DEATH VALLEY

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 23 at 10:51AM PDT until October 24 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Death Valley National Park.

* WHEN...From 11 PM this evening to 11 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
